name: Party Standee: "Shining Gem"
description: A dancer standee serving as a landmark for the dance party co-hosted by the People of the Springs, the Children of Echoes, and the Flower-Feather Clan at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. It faithfully captures the free-spirited movements and expressions of the Children of Echoes' featured dancer, Kachina.\nWhile she may be relatively new to the spotlight, Kachina's potential is well beyond her humble self-assessment. Barbara firmly believes that her talent will one day shine as brightly as a precious gemstone.\nTrying out unfamiliar steps and discovering unexpected dynamism in seemingly simple movements — it is this very thrill of artistic exchange that unites the event's organizers.
